name: Main Laboratory
description: Lab 2, where the Argus-7 was built and calibrated. Work benches, oscilloscopes, and a locked calibration cabinet. Only lab staff hold cards for this door.
arrival: Oscilloscopes hum on every bench. Dr. Voss looks up from her notes; across the room, Alex Reyes is already on his feet to greet you.

spots.label: Search Reyes's locker
spots.text: Behind a spare lab coat, a bank envelope, torn open. Ridgeway Savings & Loan. FINAL NOTICE, in red.

spots.label: Look over Dr. Voss's desk
spots.text: Her notebook lies open where she left it. The handwriting gets angrier the further you read.

spots.label: Inspect the calibration bench
spots.text: Neat as a pin. The gyro rig has been switched off since Friday. Nothing here but good housekeeping.

name: Communications Room
description: Houses the switchboard, the modem bank for remote maintenance, and the CCTV recorders that feed every camera in the building.
arrival: Warm air and the chatter of relays. Daniel Cho is already explaining something before you reach him.

spots.label: Check CCTV recorder three
spots.text: The recorder's timer log is taped to its lid. Thirty minutes in SERVICE MODE on Friday night.

spots.label: Read the modem bank printout
spots.text: Every dial-in, line by line. One call at 21:09 from a residential number.

name: Storage Room B
description: A windowless secure room with a single magnetic-card door. The Argus-7 prototype was kept here in a foam-lined case. One camera covers the door.
arrival: A windowless room, a single shelf, and a foam-lined case with nothing in it.

spots.label: Take the fingerprint report from the scene team
spots.text: Prints on the case: Voss's, and a fresh partial that matches Reyes.

spots.label: Examine the storage-room door
spots.text: No forced entry. Door opened only by a valid magnetic card.

spots.label: Look at the empty prototype case
spots.text: The Argus-7 case, found open and empty on the shelf.

spots.label: Examine the empty case
spots.text: The foam cut-out is undisturbed. Whoever lifted the unit out knew exactly how it seated. Nothing the file doesn't already tell you.

spots.label: Take the scene report to Facilities for the card-reader log
spots.text: Facilities read the reference off the locksmith's report and hand over the Storage Room B reader printout.

name: Executive Office
description: The managing director's suite. Board papers, a private line, and a typewriter that never seems to stop.
arrival: Deep carpet, a view of the whole industrial park, and Victor Lang already standing at the window.

spots.label: Try Lang's outbox
spots.text: His secretary steps in front of it. "Not without Mr. Lang's say-so, Detective." Twenty minutes of polite refusal.

name: Parking Garage
description: Staff garage with a ticket barrier on the exit ramp and a card-locked stairwell door that opens into the ground-floor corridor.
arrival: Concrete, oil stains, a ticket barrier on the ramp, and a stairwell door with a card reader and no camera.

spots.label: Read the executive bay barrier roll
spots.text: Only one permit used the executive bay on Friday night.

spots.label: Go through the staff barrier roll
spots.text: Hundreds of tickets for Friday alone. Without a permit number to look for, it's a haystack. You give up after an hour of squinting.

spots.label: Check the stairwell door reader
spots.text: The reader's memory still holds Friday night. One card, after hours.

spots.label: Look for Reyes's car on the staff barrier roll
spots.text: He went out through the lobby at 21:00 and back in by the stairwell at 21:07, so his car never left. With a name to look for, the staff roll gives it up: permit A-117, out at 21:44, and a barrier-camera still.

name: Lobby & Security Desk
description: The main entrance. A turnstile logs every card in and out, and a pressure mat under the night guard's chair records when the desk is unattended.
arrival: The turnstile clicks behind you. Nina Okafor sits very straight at the night desk, a cold coffee at her elbow.

spots.label: Pull the turnstile printer roll
spots.text: Friday evening's exits, in faded purple ink.

spots.label: Watch lobby camera tape 3
spots.text: You spool to 21:00. A man leaves with a canvas bag over his shoulder.

spots.label: Check the night desk's sensor printout
spots.text: The pressure mat under the guard's chair prints when the desk is empty.
